Build a pseudo-spectra MGF from mzML file(s) and a target list

Source: R/api.R
process_targetlist.Rd

Targeted route: no peak detection. Every target is extracted from every file, in a fixed RT window around its rt. Same stages and tmp_dir layout as process_xcms(), except that prepare writes only manifest.csv and fd.rds (no subsampling, no top-N ranking).

Usage

process_targetlist(
  input,
  output = NULL,
  targetlist = NULL,
  tmp_dir = NULL,
  stage = c("all", "prepare", "sample", "filter", "finalize"),
  sample_idx = NULL,
  sample_file = NULL,
  ppm = 20,
  rt_width = 15,
  grouper = NULL,
  group_statistics_fn = NULL,
  filter_fn = NULL,
  fdr_thresh = 0.1,
  cor_thresh = 0.1,
  min_count = 10L,
  batch_idx = NULL,
  n_batches = 1L,
  ion_mode = "POSITIVE",
  ...
)

Arguments

input

One mzML path, a directory of mzMLs (non-recursive), or a character vector of mzML paths. Only read by prepare.

output

MGF path. Required for "all" and "finalize".

targetlist

CSV path or data.frame (see Details). Required for "all" and "prepare".

tmp_dir

Working directory. NULL is only allowed for stage = "all", which then uses a tempfile() deleted on exit.

stage

One of "all", "prepare", "sample", "filter", "finalize".

sample_idx

Row of manifest.csv to process at "sample". Takes precedence over sample_file.

sample_file

mzML basename to process at "sample"; looked up in manifest.csv.

ppm

Used twice: at sample, the MS1 m/z tolerance for the precursor trace (converted to Da at the largest target m/z); and for the default grouper ppm_upgma(ppm = ppm).

rt_width

Total width (seconds) of the extraction window, centred on each target's rt.

grouper

A grouper closure (see grouper-contract); NULL uses ppm_upgma(ppm = ppm).

group_statistics_fn

A statistics closure (see stats-contract); NULL uses correlation_statistics(min_count = min_count).

filter_fn

A filter closure (see filter-contract); NULL uses correlation_filtering(cor_thresh, fdr_thresh).

fdr_thresh, cor_thresh, min_count

Only used to build the default filter_fn / group_statistics_fn.

batch_idx, n_batches

For "filter": process slice batch_idx (1-based) of n_batches. A slice past the last feature writes an empty parquet.

ion_mode

"POSITIVE" or "NEGATIVE", written as IONMODE=.

...

Forwarded to clean_pseudo_spectra() at "filter" and "finalize". require_rt is always TRUE on this route.

Value

Invisibly tmp_dir.

Details

Target-list handling:

  • Needs mz and rt columns; feature is optional (ids FT01, FT02, … are generated when missing).

  • If the largest rt is below 60 it is taken as minutes and converted to seconds.

  • Rows with missing mz or rt are kept and reported as DeconvERROR:MissingTargetInfo in the MGF.

At sample, files with no MS2 labels get MS levels by scan-index parity (as in process_mzml()). Samples where no target falls within the window write no parquets; stage = "all" reports them.

See also

Other api: carpediams(), process_mzml(), process_xcms()
